method: New standalone standard-library PCAP/TCP/TLS and ordered ledger reparse; no project verifier/auditor imported or called.
reviewer_independence: Same agent authored the harness/auditor. This is an independent method, not an independent author/implementation claim.
scope: Six health groups: raw network facts and roles only.
All 15 groups: source and ELF provenance and actual recorded guest exits; old nine are compatibility runs, not new heartbeat cases.
limits: No decrypted server ALPN or h2 PING contents inferred from ciphertext. ClientHello offer and plaintext ServerHello TLS1.3 selection are parsed.
Health matched replies and timeout are application observations bound to actual TCP tuple; they do not prove USB completion.
Host ACK/START timestamps are send completion/log observations, not guest receive or nc syscall timestamps. Guest ordering and actual TCP refusal are separate evidence.
Catalog ciphertext is not decoded: unique new TLS flow is correlated with successful phase RPC and executed guest sequence.
Socket FD/dev/ino is valve-owned endpoint retention, not proof of broker kernel FD ownership. Broker UID/executable and reported real TCP identity are separately checked.
Network results do not replace Root/helper cleanup or USB lifecycle acceptance. No hardware or ARM runtime result is claimed.
